video_title: Michelle Beadle Interview: Tom Brady, LeBron James & Spurs vs. Knicks!

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Michelle Beadle on the Knicks' playoff loss to the Pacers
quotes.excerpt: I don't know anyone who wakes up and says I can't stand Jalen Brunson.

text_blocks.speaker: Linda Cohn
text_blocks.text: Your Spurs, my Knicks, Knicks in five, end of story. Your thoughts?

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: I wish we could have gotten another game out of it. I didn't see us coming back from that at that point. The funny thing about it is, I actually really like that Knicks team. I don't know anyone who wakes up and says I can't stand Jalen Brunson. I couldn't imagine feeling that way. Josh Hart, a likable dude. It's a likable team. My issue that I started to run into was with fans, which we have been doing this long enough, it's very rarely the team that we have problems with, it's the fans.

quotes.speaker: Linda Cohn
quotes.summary_phrase: Linda Cohn on the behavior of NBA fan bases
quotes.excerpt: I always say that, you know how I love my teams, but 50% of the fan bases are morons.
quotes.quote: I always say that, you know how I love my teams, but 50% of the fan bases are morons. And the teams I love, because they just catch on later, right?

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Michelle Beadle on the Knicks' recent success and team culture
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks took 53 years of that and erased it. And now they're up at the top.
quotes.quote: The Knicks took 53 years of that and erased it. And now they're up at the top of the mountain, so it's brand new rules starting next season, which I'm excited. If you're a Knicks fan, be excited, because there's no reason why they couldn't do it again.

quotes.speaker: Linda Cohn
quotes.summary_phrase: Linda Cohn on the Spurs fan base's loss of faith
quotes.excerpt: I was actually saddened for the Spurs faithful. They sold their tickets, they lost their faith.
quotes.quote: I was actually saddened for the Spurs faithful. They sold their tickets, they lost their faith. Correct me if I'm wrong, but I would be embarrassed. If I were you, I'd be like, I'm really embarrassed by my fandom of these people who I thought I was a part of, and they had no faith.

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Michelle Beadle on the financial incentives for Spurs fans
quotes.excerpt: I get the finances of it all. You could sell literally tickets to one game and pay for all.
quotes.quote: I get the finances of it all. You could sell literally tickets to one game and pay for all of next season. And so I understand that. But it was such a bummer. It was, I'll say this, I was next to, I had Knicks fans on one side and Spurs fans on the other.

quotes.speaker: Linda Cohn
quotes.summary_phrase: Linda Cohn on Victor Wembanyama's reaction to losses
quotes.excerpt: I didn't like the way he acted after losses. After I praised his greatness, how articulate he is.
quotes.quote: Victor Wembanyama, freak of nature, so fun to watch. But honestly, I didn't like the way he acted after losses. After I praised his greatness, how articulate he is, and how a leader he is, and how the passion, what were your thoughts about being a diehard Spurs fan and this is your present and future and how he reacted?

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Michelle Beadle on Victor Wembanyama's competitive nature
quotes.excerpt: He is definitely wired in sort of that assassin, not to be messed with kind of mold.
quotes.quote: Unfortunately, I am wired that way. If I lose something, I am a horribly bad loser about things. But I'd like to think at the right bold age of 50, I've learned a little bit to just, it's fine, there'll be a day, we'll do it tomorrow. He is definitely wired in sort of that assassin, not to be messed with kind of mold of athlete that maybe we don't see as much of today, but we certainly all saw it in the past in certain guys.

quotes.speaker: Linda Cohn
quotes.summary_phrase: Linda Cohn on LeBron James' future and team choice
quotes.excerpt: What's in his head right now? What do you think's important to him when he makes this choice?
quotes.quote: LeBron James, 41 years young. What's in his head right now? What do you think's important to him when he makes this choice of where he's going to play next?

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Michelle Beadle on LeBron James' potential team destinations
quotes.excerpt: I still think he wants to go to Golden State. I think he and Draymond are boys.
quotes.quote: I still think he wants to go to Golden State. I think he and Draymond are boys. I think the idea of him playing with Steph after what they did in the Olympics, they looked like they had aged backwards 20 years and were having the times of their lives. For me, I think it's the Warriors. Doesn't mean they win a championship, but they do have a lot of fun.

quotes.speaker: Linda Cohn
quotes.summary_phrase: Linda Cohn on LeBron James' potential move to Golden State
quotes.excerpt: I want to believe he doesn't want to make it about him. I want to believe he wants to just have fun.
quotes.quote: I want to believe he doesn't want to make it about him. I want to believe he wants to just have fun. I think it would be great for the NBA if he goes with his buddies at Golden State. If he pulls a fast one and says, you know what, Philadelphia, you know, with Joel Embiid and Jaylen Brown, they have enough, and I'll get the ball more.

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Michelle Beadle on LeBron James joining the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: That feels different. That feels like a different motive if he were to do that.
quotes.quote: That feels different. That feels like a different motive if he were to do that. It's three Hall of Famers just hanging out and whatever else happens. And maybe Jimmy Butler, like I don't know.

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Michelle Beadle on Caitlin Clark's competitive personality
quotes.excerpt: She's not a soft and cuddly kitty cat. She's kind of a dick.
quotes.quote: The Caitlin Clark of it all is very interesting to me. I think the best thing for me personally that I'm watching happening is that she's sort of showing who she is. She's not a soft and cuddly kitty cat. She's kind of a dick. And I think showing that to a lot of people, I think it actually personally helps.
